protocol.method: Whole-frame read at 25% of the finished 4096x2560 master; three 900x450 regions per master at 100% covering upper-left architecture, centre content and lower-right detail; 200% and 300% re-checks on the highest-risk areas (banner and emblem glyph risk, manuscript marks, chain and grille geometry).
protocol.instrument: Built-in Liquid Retina XDR display with 1:1 pixel mapping; review crops were cut from the master bytes with no sharpening, rescaling for display or colour management applied.
protocol.scope_limit: Every master is a 2.58x controlled upscale of a 1586x992 approved source through one non-generative super-resolution pass. 100% review therefore shows interpolated softness rather than native 4K detail; the review asks whether the finishing chain invented or destroyed structure, not whether a 1586px source contains 4096px of detail.
protocol.not_accepted_as_evidence: Isolated image previews, thumbnails or downscaled contact sheets alone cannot pass G3; the findings below come from the master bytes at the stated scales.

W1.readability_note: Roof slates, chimneys, wet-stone facades, gas lamps and the stone bridge stay individually readable at 100%; street figures remain coherent silhouettes.
W1.detail_note: The crimson moon keeps internal cloud and crater texture at 200% and does not flatten into a solid red disk; measured highlight clipping stays at 0.015%.
W1.seam_note: No super-resolution tile seam, halo or staircase artefact along the moon rim, cloud edges or the bridge silhouette.
W1.text_like_glyph_check: The banner emblems are non-textual astrological geometry. No letters, numerals or pseudo-writing were found at 100%, 200% or 300%.
W1.structural_repetition_check: No repeated foliage, roof or masonry tile pattern from the upscale.

W2.readability_note: Fog layers stay continuous with distinct depth bands; the arch bridge, towers and stairways read as separate structures at 100%.
W2.detail_note: Walkers on the bridge and the hooded observers keep separate limbs and hood shapes at 200% instead of melting into blobs.
W2.seam_note: Cloud gradient shows no banding, blocking or tile boundary.
W2.text_like_glyph_check: No letters or pseudo-writing; the ring and staff ornaments are geometric.
W2.structural_repetition_check: Tower silhouettes are varied; no mirrored duplicate architecture.
W2.direction_note: The floating city and impossible stairways are the accepted game-metaphor direction recorded in the source approval update, not a Canon architectural claim.

W3.readability_note: Banner cloth, stone piers, candelabra flames and the iron grille remain separately readable; the ritual aisle keeps perspective depth.
W3.detail_note: Flame cores and candle bodies stay resolved at 100%; the robe emblem is clean vector-like geometry without cracks or melting.
W3.seam_note: No rim halos around the bright candelabra against the dark interior.
W3.text_like_glyph_check: The repeating emblem is a non-textual compass-rose motif on banners and robes. No readable marks anywhere.
W3.structural_repetition_check: Candle and pier spacing varies naturally; no stamped repetition.

W4.readability_note: Shelving, book blocks, the gallery railing, the reading desk and the armillary sphere separate cleanly at 100%.
W4.detail_note: Book spines carry no invented titles; the manuscript on the desk resolves at 300% as irregular ink and weathering blotches without letterforms.
W4.seam_note: No halos on candle flames or the window mullions against the dusk sky.
W4.text_like_glyph_check: Explicit 300% check of the manuscript and book covers: no readable or pseudo-readable text.
W4.structural_repetition_check: Spine widths and shelf contents vary; no duplicated book block.

W5.readability_note: The orrery rings, luminous threads, glass orbs and robed observers stay distinct at 100%.
W5.detail_note: Threads remain continuous without banding or dashes; orb-contained city silhouettes stay crisp; the astrolabe frame does not alias.
W5.seam_note: No halo or ringing along the brightest thread cores against the dark hall.
W5.text_like_glyph_check: Banner emblems are geometric; no text.
W5.structural_repetition_check: Thread crossings and orb contents are individually varied.

W6.readability_note: Display cases, glass reflections, chains, drawer fronts and the chained centrepiece remain separate at 100%.
W6.detail_note: Chain links stay linked with correct overlap at 200%; grille bars remain straight without waviness; the metal fittings keep hard specular highlights.
W6.seam_note: No glass-edge halo or double-edge ghosting on the case frames.
W6.text_like_glyph_check: No letters, numerals or labels; drawer fittings are decorative only.
W6.structural_repetition_check: The drawer grid repeats as designed furniture joinery, with varied wear and lighting rather than a stamped texture.
